title: Share bounded retries for observation and thumbnail state activities
answers: Which retry policy should Replay Vision state writes use?
Does the thumbnail workflow retry state activities for three minutes?
Where are scan and thumbnail state-write retry limits defined?
body:
Convention: Observation and media state activities in the scan and thumbnail workflows reuse products/replay_vision/backend/temporal/constants.py:STATE_ACTIVITY_RETRY and products/replay_vision/backend/temporal/constants.py:STATE_ACTIVITY_SCHEDULE_TO_CLOSE.
Enforcement: products/replay_vision/backend/temporal/workflow.py:ApplyScannerWorkflow and products/replay_vision/backend/temporal/media_workflow.py:ObservationMediaWorkflow pass these constants when scheduling the relevant activities.
Retry semantics: The shared policy allows five attempts, starting with a one-second interval capped at ten seconds; its backoff totals about fifteen seconds (1+2+4+8).
Invariant: The three-minute schedule-to-close timeout bounds the entire retry chain, including backoff, so state-write failure handling fits within the scanner execution timeout. It does not promise three minutes of retries; maximum_attempts can end the chain earlier.
Constraints: Reuse this policy for short PostgreSQL state activities; asset creation, asset ensuring, and thumbnail extraction retain their separate retry policies.
applies: Scheduling short observation and media state activities in ApplyScannerWorkflow and ObservationMediaWorkflow.
